solution:
/usr/bin/python3 -I -c "def sub(p, a, b):
    s = open(p).read(); assert a in s, p; open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(a, b))
sub('modules/secret/main.tf', 'lenght ', 'length ')
sub('modules/certificate/main.tf', '  subject = {', '  allowed_uses = [\"digital_signature\", \"key_encipherment\", \"server_auth\"]\n\n  subject {')
sub('modules/rotation/main.tf', 'rotation_day = ', 'rotation_days = ')
sub('modules/labels/main.tf', 'local.default_labels', 'local.defaults')
sub('modules/manifest/main.tf', '    var.settings.secrets,', '    \"secrets=\${join(\",\", var.settings.secrets)}\",')
sub('modules/hook/main.tf', '    labels      = var.labels', '    labels      = jsonencode(var.labels)')
"
